scope: Prepared normal late crew-order/deadline physical cases
prerequisite: Real CBE VACATING journal; matching original driver/candidate; actual corpse out and driver seat empty; live mobile vehicle/candidate; original deadline not yet expired. Same exact journal/vacancy/local actor checked unscheduled at explicit order boundary.
stimulus: Native STOP, or unassign plus native get-out followed only after physical dismount by explicit MOVE. No production callback/state/phase or replacement seat mutation is injected.
physical_acceptance: Original journal remains CANCELLED with unchanged deadline/route/candidate, no later driver acquisition, live intact actors and observation through original deadline+3s. GETOUT additionally requires25m displacement and20m new-destination improvement. Intent is sampled during both native waits and final observation.

validation.initial_focused_failure: Forbidden-command substring matched a comment; comment clarified without allowing a forced command. Focused checks subsequently passed before full build.

limits: Normal server-owned groups only; actual-provider HC tests remain separate.
VACATING prerequisite may be missed or never occur; missing prerequisite is a failure, not skipped/passed.
Native action timing and same-value ACTION ambiguity still need engine evidence.
Sampling cannot certify every possible sub-sample engine transient.
No runtime performance or whole-feature acceptance.
